text: Scoped ALE piston, sphere transport and SPH/GSPH controls Fixed prescribed-ALE piston, limited sphere transport and axisymmetric balance, plus actual GSPH and separate SPH controls. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-continuum-particle-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 5 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional axisymmetric spherical SWE subproblem. Hybrid centered meridional differences for primitive momentum and latitude-band finite-volume face fluxes for mass, advanced by RK4. Pole mass flux is zero; no equilibrium residual subtraction or correction. Fixed inputs, boundaries and reference scope are specified in inputs.json. Editorial clarification Axisymmetric nondimensional subproblem with a=g=1, Omega=2, u0=.5 and h0=10. Actual time evolution uses centered primitive momentum, finite-volume mass and RK4. Not standard Earth parameters, a full global multidimensional SWE core, exact discrete balance or a PV-conservation claim.
